name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity. This keeps the ring visible against any background while ensuring it doesn’t obscure content or blend into light themes. The trade-off is slightly less crisp focus visibility on high-contrast dark backgrounds, but it’s rare and the ring remains usable. This balances clarity for keyboard users with visual harmony across themes.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds where the 70% white inset blends the ring into the dark, making focus invisible. Use a 3px ring with a 1px #fff inset at 80% opacity instead—it’s sharper, meets contrast on both light and dark, and avoids blending. Test it in both themes with Playwright MCP’s contrast checks to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff outer stroke at 80% opacity. This guarantees WCAG 2.2 AA compliance on both light and dark backgrounds by keeping the ring distinct and readable, even where contrast drops. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring that may feel bolder on some interfaces, but it eliminates the risk of invisible focus—a critical failure for keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks looking like a border on some interactive elements, breaking WCAG’s focus indicator requirements for perceivable distinction. A better alternative is a 2px ring with a 2px #fff inset at 90% opacity—this keeps the ring crisp while ensuring contrast on both light and dark backgrounds. Test it in both themes with a screen reader and keyboard-only navigation to confirm visibility and usability.
